scope: One saved PTR dataset: literal test search, recorded declarations and paged observations. No analytical policy.

checks: real SQLite: both-endian golden groups, exact declaration metadata, all selected observations/attempt joins, zero/max test numbers, sparse keyset cursors, literal search and no-PTR empty dataset
real SQLite: default page sizes and strict invalid search/test/cursor/limit rejection, including NaN, infinity, fractions and wrong types
test-only large Unicode metadata in real SQLite: 2MiB byte cap truncates a short page and resumes without lost/duplicate declarations; original metadata restored
test-only oversized restored inventory: all four queries reject 20,001 actual declarations despite a smaller manifest; only inserted rows removed and original dataset/source verification passes
test-only observation of actual SQL: measurement pages/counts use measurements_test, attempt joins use INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, group search never scans measurements
real UI: dataset overview opens Explorer in the same tab; 58-test inventory pages 50/8 and test zero is selectable
real UI: literal search retains all declaration variants; recorded limits/scales/flags distinguish omitted, empty and special floats; 25/100-row paging preserves every observation and attempt
real UI: keyboard search and page navigation restore focus after async disable; final/first page moves focus to the available direction, test selection focuses its heading
real UI: 390px layout fits, search resets cursors, max-u32 test works, no-results state, reload and browser Back reopen retained data
real UI: exclusive-owner BUSY retry, no-PTR empty state and missing/invalid dataset recovery are actionable
test-only malformed metadata in real SQLite: bad JSON, non-object, wrong types, unknown/duplicate presence and invalid undisplayed fields are reported; originals restored
test-only injected real-worker exception: loading settles into disabled error state, retry reconnects and observations remain readable
test-only adapter failures: unsupported and unavailable states show recovery guidance without stale loading text or data loss

uniqueQueryPlans.sql: SELECT id FROM definitions LIMIT 1 OFFSET ?

WITH test_groups AS (
  SELECT test_number, MIN(NULLIF(name, '')) AS name, COUNT(*) AS definition_count,
    MAX(instr(lower(COALESCE(name, '')), lower(?)) > 0
      OR instr(CAST(test_number AS TEXT), ?) > 0) AS matched
  FROM definitions GROUP BY test_number
)
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalTests, COALESCE(SUM(matched), 0) AS matchedTests
    FROM test_groups

limitations: Large-dataset query latency was not benchmarked; executed SQL plans verify the selected-test index and device primary-key join.
Narrow layout checks do not qualify mobile browser storage; desktop Chrome and Edge are the tested runtimes.
Fault cases use explicit instrumentation in isolated profiles. No production query hooks or source uploads were added.
No histogram, PAT, yield, effective-default/scaling or retest policy is qualified by this phase.
